description: B Big Fox is a team of five students passionate about technology, innovation, and problem-solving. We aim to develop creative, data-driven solutions to real-world challenges using teamwork, research, and technology.
summary:
Fox Disaster Watch is a disaster awareness and emergency assistance web application developed by Team B Big Fox for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. The project aims to help people understand disaster risks, access relevant information, and respond more effectively during emergencies.

The application provides a disaster risk dashboard, interactive maps, disaster alerts, and a reporting system for users to share information about potential hazards in their surroundings. It also includes emergency assistance features designed to help users contact trusted people when they need support. NASA data and other relevant resources can help users better understand environmental conditions and potential disaster risks.

By bringing disaster-related information and emergency features together in one platform, Fox Disaster Watch aims to improve public awareness, support informed decision-making, and encourage community participation in disaster reporting. Our goal is to make disaster information more accessible and help individuals and communities prepare for emergencies through a simple, user-friendly digital solution.
details:
Fox Disaster watch is a disaster management web application developed by Team B Big Fox for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. It aims to make disaster-related information easier to access and help people make informed decisions during emergencies.

The application provides a disaster risk dashboard, interactive maps, alerts, and a community-based reporting system. Users can explore disaster-related information, view potential hazards, report incidents, and access emergency assistance features. The application is designed to bring important disaster awareness and response tools together in one user-friendly platform.

Our project focuses on improving disaster preparedness, promoting community participation, and making relevant information more accessible. Its creative approach combines mapping, risk awareness, alerts, and reporting within a single application rather than requiring users to rely on separate platforms.

The project was developed using web development tools and technologies, with Lovable used in the development workflow and GitHub used for source code management and collaboration. NASA data and other relevant resources are intended to support disaster awareness and environmental monitoring. The specific data sources and integrations are documented separately in our project references.

Our goal is to develop a practical, accessible solution that supports disaster awareness, encourages timely reporting, and helps communities prepare for potential emergencies.
